items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Now, you did make records with Jelly Roll, though... Oh, Lord, yeah. Don't Tell Me Nothing About My Man. And I Think I Hate a Man Like You.

ctx.x: Now, you did make records with Jelly Roll, though. I know you told me about that.
Oh, Lord, yeah. Don't Tell Me Nothing About My Man. And I Think I Hate a Man Like You.
